summary.name: Ulysses
summary.one_liner: Ulysses is a markup-based writing app for Mac, iPad and iPhone that syncs via iCloud and supports Markdown-style editing, library organization and multi-format export.
use_cases: drafting blog posts for WordPress or Medium
exporting formatted PDFs, Word documents or eBooks
summary.what_it_does: Ulysses is a writing app with a text-only editor where headlines, emphasis and comments are marked with a few characters of markup. Its library holds all texts in one place organized into nested groups, with attachments, keyword and date filters, and automatic saving with local backups. Writing goals can track daily progress or word and character limits with deadlines. Content syncs through iCloud across Mac, iPad and iPhone, and external Dropbox folders can be added to the library. Export options include plain or rich text, Markdown, HTML, PDF, Word and eBook formats, with built-in and community-made export styles, plus direct publishing to WordPress and Medium.
notable: Markup-based text-only editor with live preview of exported output
Single library with nested groups, attachments and filters, plus iCloud sync
Themeable editor and community Style Exchange for export styles
Publishes directly to WordPress and Medium
caveats: Free 14-day trial only; the page does not state ongoing pricing
Page does not specify which features need a paid purchase or subscription
